title: Add copy task IDs to board and task details
description: Copy the full task ID beside its short reference without navigating; show success or failure.

notes.text: Shared CopyTaskId button copies the full ID, stops click propagation, announces success and shows failures. Board cards use article containers and keyboard-accessible title buttons to avoid nested buttons. Detail header includes the same control beside its ID. TypeScript and production builds pass; diff check clean. No computer use.
